Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner provided an incorrect IMDb URL/ID for Harald Zwart (used nm0952846, which belongs to Silvana Zancolò). This misdirected WebSurfer to the wrong person repeatedly, preventing proper IMDb verification. Despite WebSurfer’s outputs showing the mismatch, the Planner continued to instruct using the wrong ID instead of correcting it (the correct IMDb ID appears to be nm0958969 per the search results). This erroneous instruction is the first mistake that led the investigation astray.
